scope: One qualified matched Windows sky-view pair, the entire failed six-process repeat, and one passing public-tool current observer smoke.
limits: Only the first matched pair establishes the reported before/after FPS result in this finite scene. The repeated cohort is failed and has no aggregate speedup.
Two repeated baseline intervals lost foreground/input focus. Their raw rows and apparent rates are retained as rejected measurements, not gameplay FPS comparisons.
The later valid baseline/current intervals remain listed within that failed cohort; they are not selectively promoted into an overall mean.
The baseline already includes the earlier owned-hit frame split and static chunk-cache diagnostic initializer. This is not a comparison against the published branch before all performance work.

Natural clocks, default-constructor entropy, tick accumulation, spawning, lighting, chunk work and autosaves run normally. The authored seed/scene/camera/settings match, but simulation work is not forced identical.
This does not establish unrestricted play, Far distance, original-game FPS or pixels, Linux gameplay, complete audio, long-session stability or a universal speedup.

host.processor_name_evidence: Native Win32_Processor census in the same session after timing.

scenario.other_settings: Ordinary fresh GameSettings defaults; measured context reports performance-mode1 and swap interval zero.
scenario.audio_backend: OpenAL null driver; ordinary Source sound work remains enabled.
scenario.normal_runtime_work: Actual source menu entry, saved-World construction, Timer/input, World ticks, chunk/light work, rendering, SDK swap, source pacing and autosaves.
scenario.harness_timed_work: QPC brackets actual normal frames; shallow read-only scalar/focus/FPS observations between frames. No per-frame screenshots, disk assertions, logs, Source repairs or disabled work.
scenario.qualification: Every returned row must have source focus, no Screen, SDL input focus and a live foreground window in the observer process. Retained camera Rotation must match; the owned cache remains enabled with zero raw exports; cleanup must close both native windows.

provenance.variant_scope: Both executables use the same native observer object, four SDK support objects, dependency archives and OpenAL DLL. Only the five query objects in the assembled simulation archive vary. Those archives use coherent current Player/Inventory signatures.

public_tool_smoke.command: python -B scripts/benchmarks/client_frames.py --build BUILD --out OUT --assets IMPORTED_ASSETS --artifacts ARTIFACTS --rounds 1

provenance.timestamps: Raw monotonic timing samples are retained as integers. IEEE754 camera words are value encodings, not memory addresses. HWNDs, PIDs and private paths are removed.
provenance.manifest_encoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 sorted compact JSON mappings with forward-slash repository-relative paths; executable/harness identities are recorded separately.

qualified_first_pair.scope: One matched pair only; no repeated-cohort or unrestricted FPS claim.
